entries.name: Light-Footed
entries.text: You can Disengage or Dash as a bonus action. When an enemy moves adjacent to you, you can spend your reaction to move away up to half your speed.

entries.name: Lethal Hunter
entries.text: Ranged weapon attacks gain a +1 bonus to damage die, and increase damage dealt with ranged taijutsu attacks using that weapon by 1 die.

entries.name: Generalist Passive 1
entries.text: You cannot make ability checks or saving throws at disadvantage.

entries.name: Tabula Rasa
entries.text: At the beginning of each of this adversary's turns, select one benefit that it will benefit from until the beginning of its next turn: • Attacks it makes gain a 1d4 bonus to hit. • Damage it deals gains a 1d6 bonus. • Skill checks it makes gain a 1d8 bonus.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries.text: Make 2 attacks with a melee weapon, or 3 attacks with a ranged or thrown weapon.

entries.name: Kunai (Melee)
entries.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft. Hit: (1d4 + 3) piercing damage.

entries.name: Kunai (Ranged)
entries.text: Ranged Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, range 30/60 ft. Hit: (1d4 + 3) piercing damage.
